Students compete individually (no school group needed) in standard committees on a set topic, with separate awards for each grade; country assignments are made about two weeks before the event.

The conference runs 17 April 2027 at Stratford School – Fremont Osgood, United States. It is open to students in grades 4–8 (individually or with a school group). Working language: English.

Register on IAC's regionals registration page by 2027-04-02; payment is due at least a week before the conference. Fees: one committee $85, both committees $125 (online payments carry a 5% processing fee). As at any MUN, delegates research their assigned country, write position papers, give speeches, negotiate in caucuses and draft resolutions — hands-on training in public speaking, research and diplomacy that universities value.

about.en:
International Academic Competitions (IAC), the organiser of the National History Bee and Geography Bee, runs one-day Model UN regional conferences for younger students. Students compete individually (no school group needed) in standard committees on a set topic, with separate awards for each grade; country assignments are made about two weeks before the event.

The conference runs 27 February 2027 at The Village School, Houston, United States. It is open to students in grades 4–8 (individually or with a school group). Working language: English.

Register online on the IAC tournament page by the deadline (2027-02-12); committees close earlier if full. Fees: morning committee $85, afternoon committee $85, both committees $125; optional National Qualifying Exams $20 each. As at any MUN, delegates research their assigned country, write position papers, give speeches, negotiate in caucuses and draft resolutions — hands-on training in public speaking, research and diplomacy that universities value.
